# Q&A Log — Standards Alignment
# Append-only. Do not edit past entries; add new dated entries instead.

## 2026-09-23 — Q8.1: Standards panel, drafted proactively (first pass of a domain built fresh)

**Bucket:** [Standard]/AI-draftable — same treatment given every other
from-scratch domain (Infrastructure, Networking, Workflow/Process).

**Answer:** NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001 as the formal frameworks/
standards grounding this domain — both were explicitly deferred to this
domain back when System Architecture's own Standards Alignment was
drafted. NIST SP 800-53 (AC/AU/SI families) reused from prior domains,
applied at agent-instance granularity. OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
cited distinctly in authority (community reference, not ISO/NIST) for
concrete threat vocabulary. Anthropic's RSP and MCP/A2A specs flagged but
not cited, to keep this framework vendor/provider-agnostic. METR-style
autonomous-capability evals flagged as not yet mature enough to cite.

**Status:** Pending explicit review.
